findings.title: Failed persistence still returns final=true
findings.body: If storage fills or the request directory becomes unwritable after ask succeeds, saving a final answer fails, but the handler only logs the error and still returns final=true. The request on disk remains unpinned. After writes recover, a later identical message can become the …
findings.fix: Return a tool error when persisting the pin or final result fails, rather than reporting successful finalization.
